Title: PhotoApp - Gallery & Cloud
Short description: Fast photo & video gallery with folder organization, cloud backup & easy sharing
Full description:
Experience a modern, lightning-fast, and secure photo and video gallery designed to give you complete control over your memories. Developed by YJTechnoSoft, PhotoApp combines a fluid media browsing experience with folder-wise organization, high-definition playback, multi-selection sharing, and seamless Google Drive cloud integration.

Whether you want to organize thousands of captured moments, enjoy 4K video clips, or safeguard your precious photos to the cloud, PhotoApp delivers smooth performance with an elegant modern dark and light design.

KEY FEATURES:
• All-in-One Media Gallery: Browse all your photos, screenshots, downloads, and videos in one fluid chronological timeline.
• Smart Folder & Album View: Automatically organizes your media by device folders (Camera, WhatsApp, Downloads, Screenshots) with live counts.
• Seamless Google Drive Backup: One-tap Google Sign-In to connect your personal Google Drive and backup photos and videos.
• Multi-Select & Instant Sharing: Select multiple photos and videos at once to share via messaging apps or upload to Google Drive.
• HD Photo Viewer & Video Player: Pinch-to-zoom full-resolution images and embedded video player with playback controls.
• Privacy & Security: Media is stored locally on your device. Uploads only happen with your explicit action.
